第一疑。: 問曰： 諸佛、菩薩以大悲為業，
Great Compassion is the life calling of Buddhas and Bodhisattvas.

第一疑。: 若欲救度眾生， 秖應願生三界， 於五濁三塗中救苦眾生。
Thus, those who have developed the Bodhi Mind, wishing to rescue and ferry other sentient beings across, should simply vow to be reborn in the Triple Realm, among the five turbidities and the three evil paths.

第一疑。: 因何求生淨土自安其身，
Why should we abandon sentient beings to lead a selfish life of tranquility?

第一疑。: 捨離眾生則是無大慈悲， 專為自利， 障菩提道。
Is this not a lack of compassion, a preoccupation with egoistic needs, contrary to the path of enlightenment?

第一疑。: 」答曰：
Answer.

第一疑。: 「菩薩有二種：
There are two types of Bodhisattvas.

第一疑。: 一者、久修行菩薩道， 得無生忍者，
The first type are those who have followed the Bodhisattva path for a long time and attained the Tolerance of Non-Birth (insight into the non-origination of phenomena).

第一疑。: 實當所責；
This reproach applies to them.

第一疑。: 二者、未得已還， 及初發心凡夫。 凡夫菩薩者，
The second type are Bodhisattvas who have not attained the Tolerance of Non-Birth, as well as ordinary beings who have just developed the Bodhi Mind.

第一疑。: 要須常不離佛， 忍力成就方堪處三界內， 於惡世中救苦眾生。
If they aspire to perfect that Tolerance and enter the evil life of the Triple Realm to save sentient beings, they should remain in constant proximity to the Buddhas.

第一疑。: 故《智度論》云： 『具縛凡夫， 有大悲心願生惡世， 救苦眾生者， 無有是處。
As stated in the Perfection of Wisdom Treatise: "It is unwise for human beings who are still bound by all kinds of afflictions, even if they possess a great compassionate Mind, to seek a premature rebirth in this evil realm to rescue sentient beings.

第一疑。: 』何以故？
“Why is this so?

第一疑。: 惡世界煩惱強，
It is because in this evil, defiled world, afflictions are powerful and widespread.

第一疑。: 自無忍力， 心隨境轉，
Those who lack the power of Tolerance of Non-birth are bound to be swayed by external circumstances.

第一疑。: 聲、色所縛， 自墮三塗，
They then become slaves to form and sound, fame and fortune, with the resulting karma of greed, anger and delusion.

第一疑。: 焉能救眾生？
Once this occurs, they cannot even save themselves, much less others!

第一疑。: 假令得生人中， 聖道難得，
If, for example, they are born in the human realm, in this evil environment full of non-believers and externalists, it is difficult to encounter genuine sages.

第一疑。: 或因施、戒、修福， 得生人中， 得作國王、大臣， 富貴自在。
Therefore, it is not easy to hear the Buddha Dharma nor achieve the goals of the sages. “Of those who planted the seeds of generosity, morality and blessings in previous lives and are thus now enjoying power and fame, how many are not infatuated with a life of wealth and honor, wallowing in endless greed and lust?

第一疑。: 縱遇善知識， 不肯信用，
“Therefore, even when they are counselled by enlightened teachers, they do not believe them nor act accordingly.

第一疑。: 貪迷放逸， 廣造眾罪， 乘此惡業，
Moreover, to satisfy their passions, they take advantage of their existing power and influence, creating a great deal of bad karma.

第一疑。: 一入三塗， 經無量劫， 從地獄出，
Thus, when their present life comes to an end, they descend upon the three evil paths for countless eons.

第一疑。: 受貧賤身；
After that, they are reborn as humans of low social and economic status.

第一疑。: 若不逢善知識， 還墮地獄。 如此輪迴，
If they do not then meet good spiritual advisors, they will continue to be deluded, creating more bad karma and descending once again into the lower realms.

第一疑。: 至於今日， 人人皆如是，
From time immemorial, sentient beings caught in the cycle of Birth and Death have been in this predicament.

第一疑。: 此名難行道也。 故《維摩經》云： 『自疾不能救， 而能救諸疾人？ 』又《智度論》云：
This is called the ‘Difficult Path of Practice.’” The Vimalakirti Sutra also states, “If you cannot even cure your own illness, how can you cure the illnesses of others?” The Perfection of Wisdom Treatise further states: "Take the case of two persons, each of whom watches a relative drowning in the river.

第一疑。: 『譬如二人各有親眷， 為水所溺， 一人情急，
The first person, acting on impulse, hastily jumps into the water.

第一疑。: 直入水救， 為無方便力故， 彼此俱沒；
However, because he lacks the necessary skills, in the end, both of them drown.

第一疑。: 一人有方便， 往取船筏， 乘之救接，
The second person, more intelligent and resourceful, hurries off to fetch a boat and sails to the rescue.

第一疑。: 悉皆得脫水溺之難。
Thus, both persons escape drowning.

第一疑。: 』新發意菩薩， 亦復如是。 如是， 未得忍力， 不能救眾生。
Newly aspiring Bodhisattvas are like the first individual, who still lacks the power of Tolerance [of Non-Birth] and cannot save sentient beings.
為此常須近佛， 得無生忍已， 方能救眾生， 如得船者。	Only those Bodhisattvas who remain close to the Buddhas and attain that Tolerance can substitute for the Buddhas and ferry countless sentient beings across, just like the person who has the boat.

第一疑。: 又論云： 『譬如嬰兒不得離母， 若也離母， 或墮坑井， 渴乳而死； 又如鳥子翅羽未成，
The Perfection of Wisdom Treatise goes on to state: "This is not unlike a young child who should not leave his mother, lest he tall into a well, drown in the river or die of starvation; or a young bird whose wings are not fully developed.

第一疑。: 秖得依樹傅枝， 不能遠去， 翅翮成就， 方能飛空， 自在無礙。
It must bide its time, hopping from branch to branch, until it can fly afar, leisurely and unimpeded.

第一疑。: 』凡夫無力， 唯得專念阿彌陀佛， 使成三昧，
Ordinary persons who lack the Tolerance of Non-Birth should limit themselves to Buddha Recitation, to achieve one-pointedness of Mind.
以業成故， 臨終斂念得生， 決定不疑。	Once that goal is reached, at the time of death, they will certainly be reborn in the Pure Land.
見彌陀佛， 證無生忍已， 還來三界， 乘無生忍船， 救苦眾生， 廣施佛事， 任意自在。	Having seen Amitabha Buddha and reached the Tolerance of Non-Birth, they can steer the boat of that Tolerance into the sea of Birth and Death, to ferry sentient beings across and accomplish countless Buddha deeds at will.

第一疑。: 故論云： 『遊戲地獄， 行者生彼國， 得無生忍已， 還入生死國， 教化地獄， 救苦眾生。 』以是因緣， 求生淨土，
For these reasons, compassionate practitioners who wish to teach and convert sentient beings in hell, or enter the sea of Birth and Death, should bear in mind the causes and conditions for rebirth in the Pure Land.

第一疑。: 願識其教。 故《十住婆沙論》， 名易行道也。
This is referred to as the "Easy Path of Practice" in the Commentary on the Ten Stages of the Bodhisattvas.

第一疑。: 第二疑。
Question 2.

第一疑。: 問： 「諸法體空， 本來無生， 平等寂滅。
All phenomena are by nature empty, always unborn [Non-Birth], equal and still.

第一疑。: 今乃捨此求彼， 生西方彌陀淨土， 豈不乖理哉？
Are we not going against this truth when we abandon this world, seeking rebirth in the Land of Ultimate Bliss?

第一疑。: 又經云： 『若求淨土， 先淨其心， 心淨故即佛土淨。 』此云何通？
The [vimalakirti] Sutra teaches that “to be reborn in the Pure Land, you should first purify your own Mind; only when the Mind is pure, will the Buddha lands be pure.” Are not Pure Land followers going against this truth?
Answer.

第一疑。: 「釋有二義： 一者、總答；
This question involves two principles and can be answered on two levels.

第一疑。: 二者、別答。 總答者， 汝若言： 『求生西方彌陀淨土， 則是捨此求彼， 不中理。
A) On the level of generality, if you think that seeking rebirth in the Pure Land means "leaving here and seeking there," and is therefore incompatible with the Truth of Equal Thusness, are you not committing the same mistake by grasping at this Saha World and not seeking rebirth in the Pure Land, i.e., "leaving there and grasping here"?

第一疑。: 』者， 汝執住此， 不求西方， 則是捨彼著此， 此還成病， 不中理也。 又轉計云： 『我亦不求生彼， 亦不求生此。
If, on the other hand, you say, "I am neither seeking rebirth there, nor do I wish to remain here," you fall into the error of nihilism.

第一疑。: 』者， 則斷滅見。 故《金剛般若經》云：
The Diamond Sutra states in this connection: "Subhuti, ... do not have such a thought.

第一疑。: 『須菩提！ 汝若作是念， 發阿耨菩提者， 說諸法斷滅相。 莫作是念！ 何以故？
Why?

第一疑。: 發菩提心者， 於法不說斷滅相。 』「二、別答者，
Because one who develops the Supreme Enlightened Mind does not advocate the [total] annihilation [of the marks of the dharmas.]"

第一疑。: 夫不生、不滅者，
B) On the level of Specifics, since you have brought up the truth of Non-Birth and the Pure Mind, I would like to give the following explanation. Non-Birth is precisely the truth of No-Birth and No-Death.

第一疑。: 於生緣中， 諸法和合， 不守自性， 求於生體，
No-Birth means that all dharmas are false aggregates, born of causes and conditions, with no Self-Nature.

第一疑。: 亦不可得， 此生生時無所從來，
Therefore, they have no real "birth nature" or "time of birth."

第一疑。: 故名不生。
Upon analysis, they do not really come from anywhere. Therefore, they are said to have No-Birth.

第一疑。: 不滅者， 諸法散時， 不守自性，
No-Death means that, since phenomena have no Self-Nature, when they are extinguished, they cannot be considered dead.

第一疑。: 言我散滅， 此散滅時去無所至，
Because they have no real place to return to, they are said to be not extinct (No-Death).

第一疑。: 故言不滅。 非謂因緣生外， 別有不生、不滅。
For this reason, the truth of Non-Birth (or No-Birth No-Death) cannot exist outside of ordinary phenomena, which are subject to birth and death.

第一疑。: 亦非不求生淨土， 喚作無生。
Therefore, Non-Birth does not mean not seeking rebirth in the Pure Land.

第一疑。: 為此， 《中論》偈云： 『因緣所生法，
The Treatise on the Middle Way states: "Dharmas (phenomena) are born of causes and conditions.

第一疑。: 我說即是空，
I say they are thus empty.

第一疑。: 亦名為假名， 亦名中道義。
They are also called false and fictitious, and that is also the truth of the Middle Way."

第一疑。: 』又云： 『諸法不自生，
It also states: "Dharmas are neither born spontaneously nor do they arise from others.

第一疑。: 亦不從他生， 不共不無因，
They are born neither together with nor apart from causes and conditions.

第一疑。: 是故知無生。
They are therefore said to have Non-Birth."

第一疑。: 』又《維摩經》云： 『雖知諸佛國， 及與眾生空， 而常修淨土，
The Vimalakirti Sutra states: "Although he knows that Buddha lands / Are void like living beings / He goes on practicing the Pure Land (Dharma) / to teach and convert men."

第一疑。: 教化諸群生。 』又云： 『譬如有人， 造立宮室， 若依空地， 隨意無礙； 若依虛空， 終不能成。
It also states: "We can build mansions at will on empty land, but it is impossible to build in the middle of empty space."

第一疑。: 』諸佛說法， 常依二諦，
When the Buddhas preach, they usually rely on the Two Truths [ultimate and conventional].

第一疑。: 不壞假名而說諸法實相。
They do not destroy the fictitious, provisional identities phenomena while revealing their true characteristics.

第一疑。: 智者熾然求生淨土， 達生體不可得，
That is why the wise, while earnestly striving for rebirth in the Pure Land, also understand that the nature of rebirth is intrinsically empty.

第一疑。: 即是真無生， 此謂心淨故即佛土淨。 愚者為生所縛，
This is true Non-Birth, and also the meaning of "only when the Mind is pure, will the Buddha lands be pure.” The dull and ignorant, on the other hand, are caught up in the concept of birth.

第一疑。: 聞生即作生解， 聞無生即作無生解，
Upon hearing the term "Birth", they understand it as actual birth; hearing of "Non-Birth," they [cling to its literal meaning] and think that there is no rebirth anywhere.

第一疑。: 不知生者即是無生， 無生即是生。
Little do they realize that "Birth is precisely Non-Birth, and Non-Birth does not hinder Birth."

第一疑。: 不達此理， 橫相是非， 嗔他求生淨土，
Because they do not understand this principle, they provoke arguments, slandering and deprecating those who seek rebirth in the Western Pure Land.

第一疑。: 幾許誤哉！
What a great mistake!

第一疑。: 此則是謗法罪人， 邪見外道也。
They are guilty of vilifying the Dharma and belong to the ranks of deluded externalists (non-Buddhists).
